provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Daily hygiene routine
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to list daily hygiene activities.
The pupils should be able to demonstrate proper bathing.

Introduction:
We all need to be clean every day. Last term we learned about keeping our bodies clean.

Content:
Daily hygiene means cleaning our bodies every day. Bathing with water and soap removes dirt from our skin. Brushing our teeth keeps our mouth clean and fresh. Combing our hair keeps it neat. We should do these things every morning before school.

Class activity:
Let's make a morning routine chart. Draw pictures of bathing, brushing teeth and combing hair. Stick them on paper in order.

Evaluation questions:
What should we do every day to stay clean?
Name two things we use to keep clean.
Why is it important to bathe every day?

Summary:
Clean bodies help us stay healthy and happy.

topics.title: Hand washing steps
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state the six steps of hand washing.
The pupils should be able to demonstrate proper hand washing.

Introduction:
Our hands touch many things all day long. We need to keep them clean.

Content:
We should wash our hands before eating food and after using the toilet. Six steps for clean hands are wet hands, apply soap, rub palms, rub between fingers, rub backs of hands, rinse and dry. Use clean water to wash off all the soap.

Class activity:
Let's practice hand washing with soap and water. We will sing a song while we wash our hands for 20 seconds.

Evaluation questions:
When should we wash our hands?
How many steps are there to wash hands?
What do we use to wash our hands?

Summary:
Clean hands keep germs away from our food and body.

topics.title: Toilet hygiene
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to explain proper toilet use.
The pupils should be able to demonstrate toilet hygiene routine.

Introduction:
Using the toilet properly helps keep us healthy and stops germs from spreading.

Content:
When using the toilet, we should sit properly on the seat. Use tissue paper to clean ourselves. Always flush the toilet after use to wash everything away. After flushing, we must wash our hands with soap and water to kill germs.

Class activity:
Let's practice the toilet hygiene routine. We will pretend to use the toilet, flush, and then wash our hands properly.

Evaluation questions:
What should we do after using the toilet?
Why do we need to flush the toilet?
What do we use to clean our hands?

Summary:
Good toilet hygiene keeps everyone healthy and stops germs.

topics.title: Healthy breakfast
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to explain why breakfast is important.
The pupils should be able to name healthy breakfast foods.

Introduction:
We all need energy to learn and play in school. Breakfast gives us energy.

Content:
Breakfast is the first meal we eat in the morning. It gives us energy to start our day. Healthy breakfast foods include bread, eggs, akara, yam, pap, fruits and milk. These foods help our brains work better in class.

Class activity:
Let's play a game. I will show pictures of foods. If it is a healthy breakfast food, stand up. If it is not, sit down.

Evaluation questions:
What is breakfast?
Why is breakfast important?
Name two healthy breakfast foods.

Summary:
A healthy breakfast helps us learn better and play more.

topics.title: Fruits and vegetables
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify different fruits and vegetables.
The pupils should be able to name the colors of fruits and vegetables.

Introduction:
Fruits and vegetables are good for our bodies. They help us grow strong.

Content:
Fruits and vegetables are healthy foods that come from plants. They have different colors like red tomatoes, green spinach, yellow bananas, and orange oranges. Eating different colored fruits and vegetables every day gives our bodies different vitamins we need to stay healthy.

Class activity:
Let's taste a new fruit today. We will wash it, cut it, and everyone will have a small piece to taste. Let's name the color and how it tastes.

Evaluation questions:
What color is a banana?
Name one vegetable you know.
Why should we eat fruits and vegetables?

Summary:
Eating colorful fruits and vegetables keeps our bodies strong.

topics.title: Junk food watch
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify junk foods.
The pupils should be able to choose healthy snacks instead of junk food.

Introduction:
Some foods are good for us every day. Other foods are only sometimes foods.

Content:
Junk foods like sweets, biscuits, soda and ice cream are not good for our bodies every day. They have too much sugar. Sometimes foods are okay to eat once in a while. Healthy snacks include fruits, groundnuts, water and biscuits made from whole wheat.

Class activity:
Let's sort pictures of foods into two groups. Healthy foods we can eat every day and sometimes foods we eat only once in a while.

Evaluation questions:
Name one junk food.
What is a healthy snack instead of sweets?
How often should we eat junk food?

Summary:
Choosing healthy foods helps us grow strong and stay healthy.

topics.title: Water for the body
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to explain why water is important.
The pupils should be able to name good times to drink water.

Introduction:
Water is very important for our bodies. It helps us stay healthy.

Content:
Water helps our bodies work properly. It keeps us cool when it is hot. It helps us digest our food. We should drink water throughout the day. When we feel thirsty, it means our bodies need water. Having our own water bottle helps us remember to drink water.

Class activity:
Let's decorate our own water bottles with stickers. We will keep them in class and drink water when we feel thirsty.

Evaluation questions:
Why do we need to drink water?
How do we know when our body needs water?
What helps us remember to drink water?

Summary:
Drinking water keeps our bodies healthy and working well.

topics.title: Posture
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to demonstrate good sitting posture.
The pupils should be able to demonstrate good standing posture.

Introduction:
How we sit and stand affects our bodies. Good posture helps us stay healthy.

Content:
Good posture means sitting and standing in the right way. When sitting on a chair, we should sit straight with our feet flat on the floor. When writing, we should not bend too low. When standing, we should stand tall with shoulders back and head up. Good posture helps our bones grow properly.

Class activity:
Let's play statues. I will call out sit straight or stand tall. Everyone must freeze in that position. The best posture wins.

Evaluation questions:
How should we sit when writing?
How should we stand?
Why is good posture important?

Summary:
Good posture helps our bodies grow strong and healthy.

topics.title: Rest and sleep
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to explain why sleep is important.
The pupils should be able to name good rest activities.

Introduction:
Our bodies need rest to grow strong and stay healthy.

Content:
Sleep is when our bodies rest and grow. Children need about ten hours of sleep every night. After lunch, we should have quiet time to rest. Good rest activities include reading quietly, lying down, or listening to soft music. Screens like phones and tablets are not good rest activities.

Class activity:
Let's practice quiet time. We will lie down on our mats, close our eyes, and listen to soft music for five minutes.

Evaluation questions:
How much sleep do children need?
What is a good rest activity after lunch?
Why do we need to sleep?

Summary:
Sleep and rest help our bodies grow and stay strong.

topics.title: Revision and hygiene check
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to demonstrate proper hygiene habits.
The pupils should be able to identify healthy foods.

Introduction:
Today we will check what we have learned about health habits this term.

Content:
We need to check our nails to make sure they are clean and short. Our uniforms should be clean every day. A healthy plate has fruits, vegetables, and foods from our local markets. We should eat a variety of foods to get all the nutrients we need.

Class activity:
Let's make a healthy plate craft. We will draw a plate and glue pictures of different healthy foods around it.

Evaluation questions:
Why should our nails be short?
What should we check on our uniform?
Name three healthy foods.

Summary:
Good hygiene and healthy foods keep us strong and happy.
